description: Germany only. Employer costs (Arbeitgeberkosten) of one employee in Germany per month and year: gross pay plus the employer share of social security (Sozialversicherung) for full-time, part-time, working students (Werkstudent) and mini-jobs (Minijob), with rates, contribution ceilings and sources. In the transition zone (Midijob, Übergangsbereich) it calculates the exact employer share with the official factor F, or only the lower bound for years whose factor F is not yet published.

gesetzlich_versichert.description: Mini-job: person has statutory health insurance, default true

pauschsteuer.description: Mini-job: employer pays the 2 % flat-rate tax, default true

stichtag.description: Any day in the month the costs apply to; the rates valid on that day are used. Default today (YYYY-MM-DD)
